# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old in Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c38 P0](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c6 P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 c6 P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012)</sub>; Aunt Thirza  <sub>[v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c8 P12](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall, slender woman whose frame possesses sharp angles rather than curves. She has dark hair streaked with gray, which she binds tightly at the back of her head in a firm bun fastened combatively by wire hairpins. She maintains an exceptionally clean and immaculate homestead.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c3 P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039)_

## Personality

Thirza is an unyielding, practical woman with a strict sense of morality and a limited background, though she harbors a quiet, redeeming sense of humor beneath her stern exterior. She values cleanliness, duty, order, and prompt obedience, often expressing her opinions abruptly. Despite her rigid demeanour, she possesses a deep capacity for compassion and maternal warmth.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c23 P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024)_

## Traits

- Strict and orderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001)</sub>
- Practical and unromantic  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c16 P3](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0003)</sub>
- Compassionate  <sub>[v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019)</sub>
- Stubborn  <sub>[v1 c9 P9](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0009), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Expert homemaking and cooking  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c16 P26](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0026)</sub>

## Goals

- To properly raise and educate Nell with morality and good manners  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c7 P14](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0014)</sub>
- To maintain Grey Shutters and keep her brother Obed comfortable  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c4 P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040)</sub>

## History

Thirza resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her quiet brother, Obed Abernethy. When they attempt to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, an error results in the arrival of a spirited, red-haired orphan girl named Nell Harcourt. Though initially intending to return Nell, Thirza's compassion is stirred by the child's plight, and she agrees to keep her. Thirza undertakes the task of instilling order, discipline, and religious instruction into Nell's imaginative nature. When her cherished amethyst brooch goes missing, Thirza temporarily confines Nell until the brooch is accidentally discovered caught in a shawl. Following the sudden death of her brother Obed due to heart trouble and the loss of their savings in a bank failure, Thirza intends to sell Grey Shutters, but Nell decides to forgo college to teach locally and remain with her. In time, as Thirza's failing eyesight prevents her from performing heavy domestic tasks, she invites her longtime friend Mrs. Agatha Sowerby to move into Grey Shutters, enabling Nell to pursue her studies at Wexcombe College. Thirza ultimately lives to see Nell successfully graduate and marry Dr. Hugh Carrow.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c7 P14](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0014), [v1 c14 P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 c36 P9](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0009), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v2 c26 P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v3 c36 P13](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0013)_

## Background by volume

- Overheard an aunt comment on her dark and homely appearance during childhood  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Had a romantic courtship with John Carrow during her youth that ended over a disagreement  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Inherited Grey Shutters and its family heirlooms from her parents  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>

> Unromantic fiddlesticks! Nell is a truly excellent, simple, and practical name. There is no reason for you to feel embarrassed by it.  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020)</sub>
